title.en: Change sums into products and products into sums

say.en: Put y equals x in the sum formulae and the double-angle formulae fall out. Add two sine values and you get a product. In this lesson: Use double- and triple-angle formulae.
Change sums into products and products into sums.

body.en: $\sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x = \dfrac{2\tan x}{1 + \tan^2 x}$; $\cos 2x = \cos^2 x - \sin^2 x = 2\cos^2 x - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2 x = \dfrac{1 - \tan^2 x}{1 + \tan^2 x}$; $\tan 2x = \dfrac{2\tan x}{1 - \tan^2 x}$; $\sin 3x = 3\sin x - 4\sin^3 x$; $\cos 3x = 4\cos^3 x - 3\cos x$; $\tan 3x = \dfrac{3\tan x - \tan^3 x}{1 - 3\tan^2 x}$.
body.kn: sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x; cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = 2cos²x − 1 = 1 − 2sin²x; sin 3x = 3 sin x − 4 sin³x.

narration.en: Sin two x is two sin x cos x. Cos two x has three forms: cos squared minus sin squared, two cos squared minus one, and one minus two sin squared. Sin three x is three sin x minus four sin cubed x.
narration.kn: sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x; cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = 2cos²x − 1 = 1 − 2sin²x; sin 3x = 3 sin x − 4 sin³x.

say.kn: sin 2x equals 2 sin x cos x; cos 2x equals cos squaredx - sin squaredx equals 2cos squaredx minus 1 equals 1 minus 2sin squaredx; sin 3x equals 3 sin x minus 4 sin cubedx.

body.en: $\sin x + \sin y = 2\sin\frac{x+y}{2}\cos\frac{x-y}{2}$; $\sin x - \sin y = 2\cos\frac{x+y}{2}\sin\frac{x-y}{2}$; $\cos x + \cos y = 2\cos\frac{x+y}{2}\cos\frac{x-y}{2}$; $\cos x - \cos y = -2\sin\frac{x+y}{2}\sin\frac{x-y}{2}$. Reversed: $2\cos x\cos y = \cos(x+y) + \cos(x-y)$, $2\sin x\sin y = \cos(x-y) - \cos(x+y)$, $2\sin x\cos y = \sin(x+y) + \sin(x-y)$.
body.kn: ಎರಡು sin ಅಥವಾ cos ಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಧ ಮೊತ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಧ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಕೋನಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಬರೆಯಬಹುದು. cos x − cos y ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಋಣ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

problem.en: sin x = 3/5 and x lies in the second quadrant. Find sin 2x, cos 2x and tan 2x.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. sin x = 3/5 and x lies in the second quadrant. Find sin 2x, cos 2x and tan 2x.

say.en: Let us solve this together. sin x equals 3 over 5 and x lies in the second quadrant. Find sin 2x, cos 2x and tan 2x.
cos x equals minus 4 over 5 in quadrant II.
sin 2x equals 2(3 over 5)(minus 4 over 5) equals minus 24 over 25; cos 2x equals 1 minus 2(9 over 25) equals 7 over 25.
tan 2x equals (minus 24 over 25)/(7 over 25) equals minus 24 over 7.
So the answer is sin 2x equals minus 24 over 25, cos 2x equals 7 over 25, tan 2x equals minus 24 over 7.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Prove (sin 5x + sin 3x)/(cos 5x + cos 3x) = tan 4x.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Prove sin 5x plus sin 3x/cos 5x plus cos 3x equals tan 4x.
Numerator equals 2 sin 4x cos x.
Denominator equals 2 cos 4x cos x.
Ratio equals sin 4x/cos 4x equals tan 4x.
So the answer is Proved.
